stories.title: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
stories.body: It comes after the country's interior minister admits that police "lost control" in some cities.

stories.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
stories.body: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.

stories.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
stories.body: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

stories.title: Tennis star Svitolina says emotional toll of Ukraine war led to Monfils separation
stories.body: The two top tennis pros married in 2021 and have one child together.

stories.title: Five ways El Niño is affecting the weather around the world
stories.body: As the strongest El Niño on record continues to intensify, what impacts on weather patterns are already being felt across the globe? Sarah Keith-Lucas looks at the evidence.

stories.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
stories.body: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

stories.title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded
stories.body: Former army sergeant major Robert Kabera was a popular YouTuber and singer, who had sought asylum in Uganda.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 50 security recruits, local authorities say
stories.body: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province that officials say was being used as a training centre for new recruits.

stories.title: US airman dies as daredevil descent goes wrong before Texas college football game
stories.body: The game continued after the incident. The American Conference said the decision was made before his death was known.

stories.title: Obama blasts federal probe of congresswoman Ilhan Omar as 'so appalling'
stories.body: Obama says federal agents' search of the Democrat's home was an effort to intimidate a Trump critic.

stories.title: Personal attacks fire up debate before Brazil's run-off vote
stories.body: The race heats up just days before the run-off between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing challenger.

stories.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'
stories.body: The blaze that killed four men and injured dozens of others spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.

stories.title: Possible wreckage of Amelia Earhart's plane likely to be trees, say researchers
stories.body: Researchers travelled to a remote Pacific Island to confirm whether an object first spotted on satellite imagery in 2020 solved the mystery of the pilot's disappearance.

stories.title: Catalonia's former rebel president can return to Spain, court rules
stories.body: The court upholds a decision to lift an arrest warrant for Carles Puigdemont linked to the independence bid he led in 2017.

stories.title: Italy plans tougher security measures after violent protests
stories.body: The government crackdown comes after protests over rising costs broke out into violent clashes.

stories.title: Trump says suspension of Russia sanctions is to keep peace negotiations going
stories.body: The US president blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect.

stories.title: Bangladesh says it was not informed of its citizens' execution by Saudi Arabia
stories.body: Saudi Arabia said it executed two Bangladeshis last week for committing an "indecent act" in a mosque.

stories.title: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff survives shooting attempt in Mumbai
stories.body: Videos showed gunmen firing shots at Shroff's car while it was moving slowly past a crowd.

stories.title: Warning signs over threats to Australian politicians were rising before MP hit by car
stories.body: In the apparent attack on MP Helen Haines, the worst fears of politicians and public figures appear to have been realised.

stories.title: In pictures: Dussehra celebrated across India as triumph of good over evil
stories.body: The festival, which commemorates the triumph of good over evil, is celebrated with different rituals across India.
